import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 12;
    static final int MAX_STEPS = 62;
    static final int MAX_NODES = 210;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 21000;

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, next;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] graph = new Edge[MAX_EDGES];
    static int[] first_edge = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int edge_index = 0;

    static void insertEdge(int from, int to, int capacity) {
        graph[edge_index] = new Edge(to, capacity, first_edge[from]);
        first_edge[from] = edge_index++;

        graph[edge_index] = new Edge(from, 0, first_edge[to]);
        first_edge[to] = edge_index++;
    }

    static int[] distance = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] queue_buffer = new int[MAX_NODES * 2];
    static int[] arc_idx = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] gap_count = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] in_queue = new int[MAX_NODES];
    static int[] parent_node = new int[MAX_NODES];

    static int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(arc_idx, -1);
        Arrays.fill(parent_node, -1);
        int queue_front = 0, queue_rear = 0;
        queue_buffer[queue_rear++] = sink;
        in_queue[sink] = 1;
        gap_count[0]++;
        distance[sink] = 0;

        while (queue_front < queue_rear) {
            int current = queue_buffer[queue_front++];
            for (int i = first_edge[current]; i != -1; i = graph[i].next) {
                int neighbor = graph[i].to;
                if (in_queue[neighbor] == 0) {
                    queue_buffer[queue_rear++] = neighbor;
                    in_queue[neighbor] = 1;
                    distance[neighbor] = distance[current] + 1;
                    gap_count[distance[neighbor]]++;
                    arc_idx[neighbor] = first_edge[neighbor];
                }
            }
        }

        int bottleneck = INF, cur_node = source, max_flow = 0;
        parent_node[source] = source;

        while (distance[source] < sink) {
            boolean augment = false;

            for (int idx = arc_idx[cur_node]; idx != -1; idx = graph[idx].next) {
                if (graph[idx].cap > 0 && distance[graph[idx].to] + 1 == distance[cur_node]) {
                    augment = true;
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, graph[idx].cap);
                    parent_node[graph[idx].to] = cur_node;
                    cur_node = graph[idx].to;

                    if (cur_node == sink) {
                        int temp_node = cur_node;
                        while (temp_node != source) {
                            temp_node = parent_node[temp_node];
                            int edge_idx = arc_idx[temp_node];
                            graph[edge_idx].cap -= bottleneck;
                            graph[edge_idx ^ 1].cap += bottleneck;
                        }
                        max_flow += bottleneck;
                        bottleneck = INF;
                    }
                    arc_idx[cur_node] = idx;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (augment) continue;

            int min_dist = sink + 1;
            for (int i = first_edge[cur_node]; i != -1; i = graph[i].next) {
                if (graph[i].cap > 0 && min_dist > distance[graph[i].to]) {
                    min_dist = distance[graph[i].to];
                    arc_idx[cur_node] = i;
                }
            }

            gap_count[distance[cur_node]]--;
            if (gap_count[distance[cur_node]] == 0) return max_flow;
            distance[cur_node] = min_dist + 1;
            gap_count[distance[cur_node]]++;
            cur_node = parent_node[cur_node];
        }

        return max_flow;
    }

    static char[][] input_grid_1 = new char[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static char[][] input_grid_2 = new char[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] scientific = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][][] stone_states = new int[MAX_STEPS][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][][][][] reachable = new int[MAX_STEPS][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] direction = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int size_n, time_limit;

    static void simulateExpansion() {
        for (int step = 1; step <= time_limit; ++step) {
            for (int row = 1; row <= size_n; ++row) {
                for (int col = 1; col <= size_n; ++col) {
                    if (stone_states[step-1][row][col] == 1) {
                        stone_states[step][row][col] = 1;
                    } else if (stone_states[step-1][row][col] == 2) {
                        stone_states[step][row][col] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nr = row + direction[d][0];
                            int nc = col + direction[d][1];
                            if (nr >= 1 && nr <= size_n && nc >= 1 && nc <= size_n) {
                                if (stone_states[step-1][nr][nc] == 2) {
                                    stone_states[step][row][col] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] visited_state = new boolean[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

    static void propagate(int start_x, int start_y, int curr_x, int curr_y, int step) {
        visited_state[curr_x][curr_y] = true;
        reachable[step][start_x][start_y][curr_x][curr_y] = 1;

        if (step >= time_limit || stone_states[step][curr_x][curr_y] != 0) return;

        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int next_x = curr_x + direction[d][0];
            int next_y = curr_y + direction[d][1];
            if (next_x >= 1 && next_x <= size_n && next_y >= 1 && next_y <= size_n && !visited_state[next_x][next_y]) {
                if (stone_states[step][next_x][next_y] != 0) continue;
                propagate(start_x, start_y, next_x, next_y, step + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        size_n = scanner.nextInt();
        time_limit = scanner.nextInt();

        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= size_n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= size_n; ++j) {
                input_grid_1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (input_grid_1[i][j] == 'Z') stone_states[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (input_grid_1[i][j] == 'Y') stone_states[0][i][j] = 1;
                else scientific[i][j] = input_grid_1[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= size_n; ++i) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= size_n; ++j) {
                if (line.charAt(j-1) >= '0' && line.charAt(j-1) <= '9') {
                    capacity[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        simulateExpansion();

        for (int i = 1; i <= size_n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size_n; ++j) {
                if (scientific[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MAX_SIZE; ++x) Arrays.fill(visited_state[x], false);
                    propagate(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int s = 1; s <= time_limit; ++s) {
            for (int a = 1; a <= size_n; ++a) {
                for (int b = 1; b <= size_n; ++b) {
                    for (int c = 1; c <= size_n; ++c) {
                        for (int d = 1; d <= size_n; ++d) {
                            reachable[s][a][b][c][d] += reachable[s-1][a][b][c][d];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int source_node = 0, sink_node = size_n * size_n * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(first_edge, -1);
        edge_index = 0;

        for (int r = 1; r <= size_n; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= size_n; ++c) {
                insertEdge(source_node, (r-1)*size_n + c, scientific[r][c]);
            }
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= size_n; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= size_n; ++c) {
                insertEdge(size_n*size_n + (r-1)*size_n + c, sink_node, capacity[r][c]);
            }
        }

        for (int x = 1; x <= size_n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= size_n; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= size_n; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= size_n; ++ny) {
                        if (scientific[x][y] != 0 && capacity[nx][ny] != 0 && reachable[time_limit][x][y][nx][ny] != 0) {
                            insertEdge((x-1)*size_n + y, size_n*size_n + (nx-1)*size_n + ny, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(source_node, sink_node));
    }
}
